rows.text: Trick 1: Family-theme answers score by CONTRAST — joint vs nuclear, tradition vs modernity; present both sides before your stance.  ·  Trick 2: For 'describe your family' style free writing, use one vivid specific detail per member instead of general praise — specific detail is the top-band marker.
